name: WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management
summary: Private business school in Vallendar on the Rhine; one bachelor's, a 3-year BSc with two internships and a semester abroad, on an English track.

ib.text: A full IB Diploma; no points minimum is published; apply on predicted grades. WHU selects by its own written test, online assessment and interviews. An English-taught school may exempt you from an English test.

dates.label: Round 1 written test and online assessment (20–21 Feb); interviews 12–14 Mar
Round 2 written test and online assessment (17–18 Apr); interviews 7–9 May
Round 3 written test and online assessment (29–30 May); interviews 19–20 Jun

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Business Administration
programmes.ib: Taught in English or German/English; choose the English track. English at TOEFL iBT 95, IELTS 7 or C1 Advanced (grade C), unless your school teaches in English.

notes: The application fee is €75 from 1 February to 31 March 2027 (with a voucher code) and €150 from 1 April to 15 May 2027.
A WHU Global IB Scholarship covers 20% of tuition for top IB graduates of any nationality.
WHU lists a 6-week internship among its requirements and builds two more (at least one abroad) into the degree; ask when the six weeks must be done.
